item.title: Louise Porton Murdered Her Daughters Weeks Apart
item.description: Lexi Draper and Scarlett Vaughan died less than three weeks apart in 2018. Medical evidence and their mother’s internet searches helped investigators establish what happened. Louise Porton was convicted of both murders in 2019 and sentenced to life with a minimum term of 32 years.

item.title: Lucy Letby Trials and the Evidence Behind Her Convictions
item.description: Former neonatal nurse Lucy Letby was convicted of murdering seven babies and attempting to murder seven others at the Countess of Chester Hospital. This overview examines the prosecution’s evidence, her defence, and the verdicts. She denies wrongdoing, and her convictions remain under review by the Criminal Cases Review Commission.

item.title: A Survivor Helped Police Identify the Chicago Ripper Crew
item.description: A survivor’s account and other witness statements helped investigators identify four men linked to attacks on women around Chicago in 1981 and 1982. The investigation led to murder convictions for three members and an attempted murder conviction for Robin Gecht.

item.title: Tracie Andrews Invented a Road Rage Killer to Hide Murder
item.description: Tracie Andrews claimed a stranger killed her fiancé Lee Harvey during a road rage incident in Worcestershire in 1996. She publicly appealed for help finding the attacker, but investigators challenged her story. In 1997, she was convicted of Harvey’s murder and sentenced to life.

item.title: A Captive Teen Helped Police Catch John Jamelske
item.description: In 2003, a 16-year-old held captive by John Jamelske called her sister during an errand, helping police uncover kidnappings spanning 15 years. He pleaded guilty to five kidnapping counts and was sentenced to 18 years to life. Individual victims were held for months or years.

item.title: Five Women Testified That Phil Spector Threatened Them With Guns
item.description: At Phil Spector’s murder trial, five women described earlier incidents in which he threatened them with guns. The music producer was convicted of murdering actress Lana Clarkson in 2009 and sentenced to 19 years to life in prison.
